newsitem.title: CHINA: China rate cuts to save firms 100 bln yuan a year.
newsitem.headline: China rate cuts to save firms 100 bln yuan a year.

text.p: Interest rate cuts by China this year would slash interest payments on loans by businesses by more than 100 billion yuan ($12 billion) a year, the China Securities newspaper said on Wednesday.
In the remaining four months of 1996, businesses would save more than 30 billion yuan in interest payments on loans totalling 6.0 trillion yuan, the newspaper said.
Banks would pay 80 billion yuan less a year in interest payments on individual savings deposits and would pay out 20 billion yuan less in the last four months of 1996, it said.
Individual savings deposits totalled more than 3.5 trillion yuan at the end of June, it said.
China has cut interest rates on bank loans and deposits in May and August this year.
